sections.overview: Scinax eurydice is a Brazilian treefrog recorded along the country’s Atlantic side, from the northeast toward São Paulo.
sections.identification: Adults are medium-sized, with brown to greenish backs and paired dark marks.
sections.habitat: It is arboreal at forest edges or open, altered habitats near ponds.
sections.diet: Adult diet is not specified in the sources reviewed.
sections.behavior: Males call from vegetation above water.
sections.reproduction: Eggs are laid in water, where tadpoles develop; local breeding seasons vary.
sections.ecology: Genetic studies indicate that the name may cover a complex of distinct lineages, so records across its broad range may not all represent one biological species.
sections.conservation: The IUCN category is reported as Least Concern, but the possible species complex makes range-wide interpretation less certain.
